name: North Brunswick Dental Group
what_they_do: Single-dentist general and cosmetic dental practice (Dr. Mira Peyyeti) at 985 Patton Street, offering general dentistry, cosmetic procedures, online payments and downloadable patient intake forms.
customers: Local North Brunswick families and adults; Spanish-language listing presence in directories - inference from directory entries, not from the site.

size_signals.signal: One dentist named on the site (Dr. Mira Peyyeti); no team page content beyond a 'Meet the Team' link
Hours Mon/Tue/Thu 8am-7pm and Sat 8am-1pm, i.e. two long days a week
Birdeye shows 1.0 from only 3 reviews for Dr. Peyyeti - thin and unfavourable online reputation

listing.platform: Birdeye (Google-sourced reviews); Wellness.com lists the practice with 2 reviews

website_review.primary_cta: 'Contact Us' homepage form (name/email/subject/message) plus 'Call 732-249-7100'; nothing bookable
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Homepage contact form only; no appointment request fields, no calendar, no booking platform
website_review.trust_signals: Practice-album photos link, practice-selected testimonials page, online payments link - but no visible rating badge and only 3 external reviews
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Footer reads '©2019 by North Brunswick Dental Group. Proudly created with Wix.com'; intake forms are PDFs including a 'COVID QUESTIONNAIRE'; the layout is a fixed-width 2019-era Wix build, which at 390 px puts the nav buttons on top of the office address and cuts menu items off-screen; only 683 characters of text on the homepage
website_review.search_basics: Title 'Cosmetic Dentistry | Nbdgnj.com | United States' uses the domain instead of the town, and the meta description is generic; services are listed as a single page rather than dedicated service pages
top_issues: Mobile layout is broken - nav buttons overlap the address block and overflow the screen
Site has not been updated since 2019 and still links a COVID questionnaire; copyright says 2019
No online booking, and the only form is a generic contact box with no appointment details
Homepage has ~683 characters of text; title tag uses the domain rather than 'dentist North Brunswick'

agent_readiness.notes: Only a WebSite JSON-LD block - no LocalBusiness/Dentist node with address, hours or phone, so an agent has to scrape the page. Hours and address are readable text, but the whole homepage is ~683 characters and there is no service/price detail. A visitor can send a message but cannot request a time; the form is a Wix form with anti-bot protection. robots.txt not checked.

operations_signals.signal: New-patient intake is a set of print-and-fill PDFs (personal info, medical history, HIPAA, consent, COVID questionnaire)
Appointments are phone-only: 'Please call us at 732-249-7100 today to schedule'
Very small, low review volume (3 reviews) with one poor rating - inference: no systematic review-request process

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild the site on a modern mobile-first platform with real service pages, appointment requests and click-to-call - the current build is broken on phones and eight years stale
top_opportunities.evidence: Broken 390 px layout (nav overlapping the address), ©2019 footer, COVID questionnaire still linked

top_opportunities.opportunity: Digitise intake: replace the five printable PDFs with an online form that writes into the practice's records, and add a simple scheduler
top_opportunities.evidence: The /forms page instructs patients to 'print and fill' five PDF documents before their visit

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add LocalBusiness/Dentist schema plus automated review requests - the practice currently has only 3 public reviews and no rating on its own site
top_opportunities.evidence: Only a WebSite schema block is present; Birdeye shows 3 reviews at 1.0

scores.reasons: Nearly everything is missing or broken - stale 2019 Wix site, broken mobile layout, PDF intake, no booking, almost no reviews; a single-dentist practice with a 1.0/3-review footprint suggests limited budget and limited marketing spend; the fixes themselves are simple, well-understood work; all evidence gathered directly from the live site.
